proposition: The folio references for works in MS Majlis 10196 cannot all be taken at face value as an ordering key: the Sharḥ-i Ḥadīs-i ʿAmāʾ (ff. 119b-20b) and the R. fī Sharḥ Ḥaqīqat al-Waḥda (f. 120a-20b) overlap; the Naẓm al-Durr is printed at ff. '-1b-51b'; the Tamhīd end is printed '23a' (presumably 223a); the Tarjuma is at ff. 440b-41b in a manuscript given as 425 ff.; and the Tuḥfa-yi ʿAlāʾī range 375b-82a overlaps the reported interjected fragment at ff. 374b-75b.

mediation.who: R4 (researcher pass), comparing the entries' folio ranges
mediation.note: observation about the source's own inconsistencies; the collection-ordering puzzle should not treat these ranges as exact without a check
